system.help: The system under study, labelled System: name or short description of the technical unit whose evolution is placed on the eight trends. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the field.

trends.help: The eight evolution trends, one card per trend with number, name and description. Each trend holds the stage reached and a note. Seven trends have a stage ladder; uneven development is qualitative and has only the note. The trends are written as a whole with all eight entries.

stage.help: The stage the system has reached on this trend's ladder, counted from 0 (the first stage is 0); -1 means none is chosen yet. Dynamism has five stages, the other six trends with a ladder four each; uneven development has none and always stays at -1. A stage outside the ladder is rejected.

notes.help: The note on the trend: why the system sits at this stage and what the next stage jump would look like; for uneven development, the subsystem that lags behind. Free text with no effect on any computation; an empty text clears the note.

setTrendStage.help: Chooses the stage a trend has reached, in the interface by clicking a stage on the card or with the arrow keys. Clicking the stage already chosen changes nothing.

params.trendId: The trend, given by its key: aggregation (Aggregation), dynamism (Dynamism), scale (Scale), automation (Automation), completeness (Completeness), controllability (Controllability), matching (Niche matching) or uneven (Uneven development). Any other key is rejected.
params.stage: The stage reached, counted from 0 (the first stage is 0); -1 clears the placement. Dynamism has five stages (0 to 4), the other six trends with a ladder four each (0 to 3). Uneven development has no stages and only takes -1; any stage outside the ladder is rejected and leaves the state unchanged.
